events.title: Ai2 releases OlmoEarth v1.3 and global 10-meter embeddings
events.title_zh: Ai2 发布 OlmoEarth v1.3 与全球 10 米嵌入
events.summary_en: Ai2 released OlmoEarth v1.3 plus annual global embeddings at 10-meter resolution in 64- and 128-dimensional forms. The model consumes one year of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Landsat observations, and the release includes weights, pretraining code, data and a browser explorer. Ai2 reports leading results on most of 27 evaluations; those comparisons are publisher-run.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 OlmoEarth v1.3，并提供 64 维和 128 维、10 米分辨率的年度全球嵌入。模型读取一年的 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2 和 Landsat 观测；发布内容包括权重、预训练代码、数据和浏览器 explorer。Ai2 称其在 27 项评测中的多数项目领先，但这些比较由发布方完成。
events.why_it_matters_en: For geospatial teams, downloadable global embeddings can remove a costly remote-sensing pretraining step and make land-use prototypes much faster. The custom artifact license and domain-specific independent validation remain gating items.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对地理空间团队来说，可下载的全球嵌入能省掉昂贵的遥感预训练，让土地利用原型更快落地。自定义产物许可和领域内独立验证仍是采用门槛。

technical_details.output: annual global embeddings at 10 m in 64D and 128D
technical_details.inputs: one year of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Landsat observations
technical_details.architecture: 128M-parameter ViT, 14.3M-parameter Perceiver and small linear student
technical_details.artifacts: weights, pretraining code, data and browser explorer
technical_details.reported_evaluation: 128D best on 20 of 27 evaluations; 64D best on 18 of 27
technical_details.time_basis: official Hugging Face article published 2026-10-22T16:11:31Z; model card predates the announcement

technical_details_zh.输出: 64 维和 128 维、10 米分辨率的年度全球嵌入
technical_details_zh.输入: 一年的 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2 与 Landsat 观测
technical_details_zh.架构: 1.28 亿参数 ViT、1430 万参数 Perceiver 与小型线性 student
technical_details_zh.公开产物: 权重、预训练代码、数据和浏览器 explorer
technical_details_zh.发布方评测: 128D 在 27 项中 20 项最好；64D 在 18 项最好
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Hugging Face 官方文章发表于 2026-10-22T16:11:31Z；model card 早于本次公告

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开 explorer 和一小块已标注区域比较 64D、128D 嵌入与现有特征的准确率、下载成本和许可边界。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare 64D and 128D embeddings with current features on one labeled area, including quality, download cost and license limits.

evidence.claim_zh: Ai2 已公开 OlmoEarth v1.3 权重、代码、数据和全球嵌入；benchmark 仍由发布方运行。
evidence.claim_en: Ai2 has published OlmoEarth v1.3 weights, code, data and global embeddings; benchmarks remain publisher-run.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; performance claims remain publisher-reported where noted
